q: Pembersihan menggunakan stim bersuhu tinggi dikategorikan sebagai:
c: Kerja panas (hot work)
e: Definition of hot work: fire-, heat- or spark-producing operation such as welding, cutting, grinding, drilling, blasting, heating and cleaning using high temperature steam (ICOP Confined Space).

q: Kimpalan ialah proses menyambung logam dengan memanaskannya ke takat lebur:
c: Dengan atau tanpa logam pengisi
e: Welding: joining two or more metal parts by heating to a melting point and fusing, with or without filler metal.

q: 'Hot shearing' dan 'arc gouging' tergolong dalam jenis kerja panas:
c: Pemotongan (cutting)
e: Types of cutting: oxy-acetylene, plasma, arc gouging/air-carbon gouging, thermal cutting, hot shearing.

q: Pengisaran (grinding) membuang bahan daripada permukaan bahan kerja melalui:
c: Lelasan geseran roda lelas yang berputar
e: Grinding: rotating abrasive wheel or disc removes material by frictional abrasion.

q: Peletupan (blasting) boleh menggunakan:
c: Udara termampat, bahan lelas atau bahan letupan
e: Blasting: uses compressed air, abrasive materials, or explosives to clean, smooth, shape or remove material.

q: Piawaian NFPA 51B berkaitan dengan:
c: Pencegahan kebakaran semasa kimpalan, pemotongan dan kerja panas lain
e: Statutory and others: OSHA 1994; ICOP Confined Space 2010; NFPA 51B Standard for Fire Prevention During Welding, Cutting and Other Hot Work.

q: Dalam kimpalan arka elektrik, arka terhasil apabila:
c: Elektrod diletakkan hampir dengan bahan kerja keluli pada voltan tinggi
e: Electric arc welding: electrodes and high voltage produce an arc when electrode is close to the steel work material; electrode moved along the part.

q: Pemotongan plasma menggunakan arka elektrik dan gas termampat untuk memotong:
c: Logam konduktif seperti keluli dan aluminium
e: Plasma cutting: electric arc and compressed gas to cut conductive metals (steel, aluminium); intense light and sparks.

q: Pemotongan 'thermal lance' biasanya digunakan dalam:
c: Operasi perobohan atau skrap untuk bahan tebal
e: Thermal lance cutting: steel tube filled with oxygen to cut thick materials, often in demolition or scrap operations.

q: Pengisaran silinder (cylindrical grinding) biasanya digunakan untuk:
c: Aci, rod, penggelek dan gandar
e: Cylindrical grinding: removes material from outer surface of cylindrical workpiece – shafts, rods, rollers, axles.

q: Pengisaran yang digunakan untuk menajam dan membentuk mata gerudi, pemotong dan tap dipanggil:
c: Tool and cutter grinding
e: Tool and cutter grinding: precision grinding to sharpen, shape or refurbish cutting tools (drills, milling cutters, reamers, taps).

q: Penggerudian berkelajuan tinggi boleh menghasilkan percikan terutamanya apabila:
c: Mata gerudi tumpul atau bahan keras
e: High-speed metal drilling: friction and heat at high RPM; sparks may occur if bit is dull or material is hard.

q: Penggerudian penyelenggaraan dalam ruang terkurung meningkatkan risiko kebakaran dan letupan kerana:
c: Gas atau wap mudah terbakar mungkin terperangkap
e: Maintenance drilling in confined space: increased fire and explosion risk when flammable gases or vapors are trapped.

q: Peletupan pasir (abrasive blasting) menghasilkan haba dan:
c: Cas statik
e: Abrasive (sand) blasting: compressed air blasts sand/grit to remove rust/paint; friction creates heat and static charges.

q: Pendedahan berterusan kepada haba kimpalan boleh menyebabkan:
c: Kulit menjadi merah
e: Physical hazards – exposure to hot surface: hot work materials, metal sparks; continuous exposure to welding heat can result in redness of skin.

q: Sinaran inframerah dan cahaya terang daripada kerja panas boleh menyebabkan:
c: Mata kering dan rengsa
e: Radiation: UV and ozone → conjunctivitis, retina damage; infra-red and bright lights → dryness and irritation to eyes.

q: Dalam sistem permit kerja panas, kontraktor yang melakukan kerja panas dikenali sebagai:
c: Operator kerja panas (hot work operator)
e: Roles: Permit Authorizing Individual (evaluates, issues permit); hot work operator (contractor performing the work); fire watch (monitors for fire).

q: Kandungan permit kerja panas termasuk:
c: Senarai semak keselamatan kebakaran sebelum kerja dan pemantauan selepas kerja
e: Contents: administrative details, equipment/work type, authorization, pre-work fire-safety checklist, atmosphere controls, fire watch & post-work monitoring, validity, final sign-off.

q: Langkah keselamatan am bagi kerja panas termasuk:
c: Sistem pengudaraan ekzos setempat dan pemilihan pekerja yang betul
w: Menyimpan bahan mudah terbakar di kawasan kerja
e: General safety measures: fencing, fire equipment, isolate flammables, PPE; LEV, SOP, training, proper selection of workers, supervision.

q: Silinder gas oksigen dan asetilena perlu disimpan:
c: Secara tegak dan jauh daripada sumber haba serta zon kerja aktif
e: Storage: safe, dry, well-ventilated; gas cylinders kept upright and away from heat sources, flammable materials and active work zones.
